notes.note: Traditional commentaries in the packet read the psalm as addressed to Solomon, David or the Messiah, with the bride as a convert or Israel. The Hebrew itself names none of them, and I kept the drama within the text: a poet, a king and a bride. Where the commentaries diverge I cited them rather than adopting one.
